icu.notes: fr adds two plural blocks in file_preview_cap (one/many/other on size and cap) and keeps {size, number, ::group-off}/{cap, number, ::group-off} inside every arm; every other locale keeps the English shape. No locale introduces an argument English does not declare, so no translation can demand a parameter the call sites do not pass. English has no plural/select blocks in this namespace, so there are no English arms to mirror; fr's added arms are locale-correct CLDR categories (one/many/other) and are unreachable in practice because the message only renders when size > cap > 1.

review: All 139 English values read side by side with es. Tuteo throughout (Vuelve/Comprueba/Intenta), matching the es catalogue's established address form; no usted drift. Terms consistent except the two minors recorded: 'media request' has two renderings, and the B-wave 'vinculada' for 'paired' diverges from the es pairing vocabulary ('emparejada'). Infinitive/imperative error style is consistent, sentence case and terminal punctuation match English key by key. 'app' vs 'aplicación' follows the English app/application distinction (Esta app in desktop_refusal.*, La aplicación in error_boundary), so it is not drift.
overflow: No width-constrained control labels in this namespace: all values are error-band/toast sentences that wrap. Material expansion among the shortest strings (rendered-check candidates, not proven defects): file_too_large 20->37 characters, file_not_file 10->16, no_details 26->37. The systematic 'X request failed' -> 'Error en la solicitud de X' pattern runs ~1.7-1.9x on request messages; acceptable for a wrapping band, worth a glance if any of them lands in a fixed-width toast.
